name: Add tests for the Python code.symbols rules

source.note: TOOLS-09 Python rules: ^\s*(?:async\s+)?def and ^\s*class, comments skipped. Seed already has the scanner; the task is to add tests/test_symbols.py covering those cases. Hidden overlay requires that file.

description: symbols.py already implements the TOOLS-09 Python lexical rules: leading def / async def / class names, comment lines skipped. Add tests/test_symbols.py that imports symbols and covers a plain def, an async def, a class, and a commented-out def that must not appear. Do not change the scanner unless a test proves it is wrong. Hidden verification will refuse the workspace if tests/test_symbols.py is missing.
